pipeline.message: Started the pipeline for release/1.4.0: it has no open pull request.

manualDownmerge.text:
Manual downmerge needed: release/1.4.0 → develop

1.4.0-RC.2 is pushed and tagged, but release/1.4.0 conflicts with develop, so no pull request into develop was opened. Conflicted files:
  - Gemfile.lock

Steps:
  1. Cut release-1.4.0-into-develop-<unix-timestamp> off origin/develop and merge origin/release/1.4.0 into it.
  2. Resolve the conflicts in Gemfile.lock. Keep develop's VERSION.
  3. Push release-1.4.0-into-develop-<unix-timestamp> and open a pull request into develop titled "Release 1.4.0 to develop", listing each resolved file with a one-line reason.

The full procedure is docs/manual-downmerge.md in the versioner repository (https://github.com/officespacesoftware/versioner/blob/master/docs/manual-downmerge.md).
